topic: Structuring lidar session data in ClickHouse
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on defining the schema for a new `lidar2d_session` table to store 2D lidar session data. Initial proposed fields included `lidar_id`, `area_id`, `start`, `duration`, and `empty_frames`. There was debate regarding the appropriate data types, specifically whether timestamps should be stored in nanoseconds (uint64) or if microseconds/milliseconds would suffice, given the expected low frequency of data capture. The consensus leaned toward using a more manageable time unit like milliseconds.

[me] advised that instead of building the table from scratch, [p1] could reference an existing schema pattern, such as `device_session_concept`, found in internal SQL files (e.g., `stuff/clickhouse`).
decisions: The new lidar session data structure will be implemented using ClickHouse.
The time unit for start and duration should ideally be milliseconds or microseconds, rather than nanoseconds.
action_items: [me] to provide a corrected version of the `lidar2d_session` table schema.
